title: The library says I borrowed my own diary 📖

hook_text: At 11:52 p.m. my library emailed me.

scenes.narration: At 11:52 p.m. my library emailed me. A book I never borrowed was due tomorrow.

scenes.narration: I opened it. The title was my own diary. The one I buried in the garden when I was twelve. I never told anyone it existed.

shots.prompt: an old open diary with yellowed pages lying on a wooden desk under a warm lamp, close-up, no readable text

scenes.narration: I grabbed a torch and ran outside. The hole was open. Empty. The dirt was still wet.

shots.prompt: wide shot of a garden at night, a shovel stuck in a mound of dark soil beside an empty hole in the lawn, a bright flashlight beam from above

scenes.narration: Then my phone buzzed. Return date: tonight. Borrowed by: me.

shots.prompt: a smartphone lying on grass at night seen from above, screen glowing bright white, wet grass around it

scenes.narration: Behind me the back door clicked shut. Someone had just returned it.

shots.prompt: back door of a house at night wide open, bright warm light pouring out onto the patio with a long dark shadow stretching across the grass, wide shot, no people

scenes.narration: So tell me. Do you go back inside, or run?
